messages:
ana.marketing: Hey runtime — we’re finalizing the launch blog and need a quick smoke rerun of the benchmark claims. Can you run a focused 1–2 hour validating sweep so we have reproducible artifacts for the writeup?

ana.marketing: Requirements: gen path (text) + embed path, model baseline (float32) and quantized variant, p50/p95/p99 latency, 95th token cost, and a short methodological note we can paste into the blog. Prefer seq_len=1024 and a short tail cohort (long prompts ~ 4% of samples).

josh.runtime: We can do that. A few clarifying Qs: exact model name (or family), region, concurrency target, and whether you want coldstart-only or steady-state metrics. Also do you need raw request traces and sample payload bundle?

ana.marketing: Use "redwood-open-13b-v2" as the baseline. Quantized variant: q4_0 (or whatever is closest on the catalog). Region: us-west-2. Concurrency target ~ 50 rps for gen, 200 rps for embeds. Steady-state is most important, but include a 15m coldstart segment. Yes please include raw traces + sample payloads + run recipe.

priya.data: Adding the sample prompt set we want to use — 1k prompts with stratified lengths (short/medium/long). I’ll attach the seed list and an example curl for the payloads: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-13b-v2","input":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":256}'
```

priya.data: We’ll provide the full 1k prompt file in the artifacts bucket and the 100-seed sub-sample for quick smoke.

sam.sre: One ask from infra: do not run this on shared-prod pool. Please use the dedicated bench-qa queue so runners don’t evict other customers. Also include KV-cache hit rate and memory pressure metrics for each run. For coldstarts capture instance boot times + first request tail.

josh.runtime: Got it. Plan: schedule a 2-hour window tomorrow 09:00–11:00 PT in bench-qa. Steps: warmup 15m -> steady-state 60m -> coldstart sweep 15m -> quantized vs float sweep 30m. We’ll collect p50/p95/p99, token-level cost, batching stats, KV cache hit%, and raw request traces (sampled 1%).

josh.runtime: Output artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-bench/1795559999/{run_manifest.json,summary.csv,raw_traces.tar.gz,sample_payloads.json,methodology.txt}

ana.marketing: Perfect — can you add a short plain-English methodology blurb we can copy into the blog (1–2 paragraphs) and a 1-slide heatmap image for the PR deck?

josh.runtime: Will do. I’ll write the methodology note and attach the heatmap. Expect a preliminary summary in the channel within 3 hours of the run finishing.

runtime-bot: Bench job scheduled by josh.runtime: job_id=bench-2026-1795559999 run_window=2026-03-24T16:00:00-07:00 duration=2h queue=bench-qa

ana.marketing: awesome — thank you all. If we spot any odd deltas we’ll call a quick sync. :thumbsup:
